visual_action: The video presents itself as a tutorial on how to make a photo look nostalgic. It starts with a glum-looking photo of Donald Trump, then uses a photo of Donald and Melania Trump as the example image. It shows a screen recording of a photo editing app, instructing the viewer to select the 'vintage' filter. The final reveal is not the edited photo of the Trumps, but a different photo of Donald Trump with Jeffrey Epstein, to which the 'vintage' filter has been applied.
